﻿Ring - Drone Launch Clipping
Platforms: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
Launch date: November 10, 2026
✔ You do not need a dedicated page for this campaign. You can post on any page.
WHAT TO DO
Clip videos of the new Ring Drone.
Focus your posts on the Ring Drone.
Post to TikTok, Instagram Reels, and/or YouTube Shorts.
Content folder: https://f.io/MDNPT7wx 
	

Use only footage from Ring's official folder.
Outside footage, news clips, photos, logos, and music are rejected.
	CAPTION GUIDELINES (REQUIRED)
Pick one approved caption.
Copy it word for word.
Every caption already includes @Ring and #ad.
APPROVED CAPTIONS
* first look at the Ring Drone 👀 @Ring #ad
* Ring just showed off the Ring Drone @Ring #ad
* Ring just announced the Ring Drone @Ring #ad
* a closer look at the Ring Drone from @Ring #ad
* this is the new Ring Drone from @Ring #ad
* the new Ring Robotics lineup is here👀 @Ring #ad
* first look at Ring Robotics @Ring #ad
* Ring just showed off its new robotics lineup @Ring #ad
* Ring announces Ring Robotics, ushering in a new era of autonomous security @Ring #ad
	DO NOT ADD
❌  Other hashtags, tags, or links
❌  Political messages or other brands
FTC DISCLOSURE (REQUIRED)
Every post must include this in the caption:
#ad
	#ad is already in every approved caption. Do not remove it.
Do not move it or hide it among other hashtags.
Use #ad only. No other disclosure tag.
Turn on the paid partnership label where the platform offers it.
PRODUCT ACCURACY (REQUIRED)
Only mention features Ring has shared.
No made-up specs, prices, or dates.
Do not say the product is for sale.
Renders are not real footage. Never present them as real recordings.
No claims about safety, privacy, or reliability beyond Ring's copy.
Do not edit content in a way that changes its meaning.
PEOPLE AND CHILDREN (REQUIRED)
Do not add any footage or images of children.
No children using, setting up, or talking through Ring devices or the app.
Do not mention children in captions or on-screen text.
Do not add any person's face or name that is not in Ring's content.
Make content for adults. Do not aim it at kids or teens.
ON-SCREEN TEXT (OPTIONAL)
On-screen text is up to you.
If you use it, it must match what is shown in the clip.
Keep it about the Ring Drone.
Keep it genuine and true. No made-up facts, stats, or dates.
EDITING GUIDELINES
Background music: NOT ALLOWED. Use the original audio only.
No AI voices. No AI voiceovers, AI narration, or AI-cloned voices.
No AI-generated footage, images, or voices.
	Do not use AI to create Ring footage or product demos.
Do not create fake security camera recordings.
Do not create fake statements, voices, or faces of real people.
Do not screen record or upscale Ring footage.
Do not add logos to the screen.
Normal editing is fine: cutting, cropping, text, captions, audio leveling, color correction, transitions.
REQUIREMENTS
POST SPECS
✔  High-quality posts only. No blurry or low-effort content.
✔  English content only
✔  Post must stay live for 30 days minimum
PERFORMANCE
✔  Minimum 0.50% engagement rate (1,000 views = at least 5 likes)
✔  Likes must be visible. Hidden likes = automatic rejection.
✔  Page audience should be mostly Tier 1-2 countries (30%+ Tier 3 may be removed)
✔  By participating you agree to make your post FTC compliant
NOT ALLOWED
CONTENT
❌  Footage not from Ring's official folder
❌  AI-made footage or images
❌  Made-up features, prices, or dates
❌  Renders shown as real camera footage
❌  Children using Ring devices
❌  Tagging other brands, people, or outside links
❌  Low-quality or lazy uploads
❌  NSFW, violent, or controversial content
❌  Racist, homophobic, or sexual content = instant ban
❌  Reposting another creator's video as your own
❌  Exaggerated hooks, rage bait, or hate bait
❌  False or made-up claims, stats, or dates
❌  Any added music
❌  AI voiceovers or AI-generated voices
ENGAGEMENT FRAUD
❌  Bait posting: unrelated viral content to farm views
❌  Spam posting: the same video on multiple accounts
❌  Story boosting: story views do not count
❌  Paid promotion or ads of any kind = permanent ban
❌  Posting the same video more than 5 times
POST VIOLATIONS
❌  Caption not from the approved list
❌  Missing #ad
❌  Removing the post before 30 days
❌  Hidden likes
Questions? Contact the Clipping Culture team, not Ring. We are managing this campaign and will help.
